collected_scrolls: TAPE 01 [00:12] You have been selected for the Program. Walk forward. Do not look for the camera.
NOTE 00 [SCRATCHED] THIS ROOM LOOKED SMALLER THE LAST TIME. I KEEP COUNTING THE SAME NUMBER.
NOTE 02 [STICKY] I counted. It is 8 steps.
TAPE 01 [01:05] Doors are provided. Keys are provided. This is not a metaphor.
TAPE 01 [01:58] Some footage of this wing is missing. This is normal. Continue.
NOTE 03 [SCRATCHED] THE WALL AT THE END OF THE ROOM IS NOT THE SAME COLOR. I DID NOT TOUCH IT. I SHOULD HAVE.
TAPE 01 [02:41] A figure has entered frame. It is DESIGNATION 01. It has always been here. Do not greet it.
TAPE 01 [03:30] The ceiling in the east passage was measured incorrectly on purpose. Duck.
TAPE 01 [04:12] Some of the floor was removed during a previous intake. It was not replaced.
NOTE 07 [SCRATCHED] DON'T LOOK AT THE LIGHT. IT KNOWS.
TAPE 01 [05:03] DESIGNATION 01 will not deviate from its route. You are permitted to.
TAPE 01 [05:47] Orientation is complete. Tape 02 introduces personnel. Do not skip ahead.

TAPE 01 [07:10] ANOMALY: UNLISTED. This entity has not been assigned a designation. It appears only in doorways. We do not know where it goes when it is not in one. When a door begins to glow, do not be in front of it.
NOTE 10 [FORM] INTAKE 22. STATUS: UNRECORDED.
TAPE 02 [04:40] This is DESIGNATION 01. It walks the same eleven steps it has always walked. Do not interrupt its count.
TAPE 02 [05:22] More than one DESIGNATION 01 has been logged in this hallway. They do not acknowledge each other. Neither should you.
NOTE 11 [STICKY] the draft comes from inside the wall. Someone left a battery here.
TAPE 02 [06:10] DESIGNATION 01 has been observed on elevated surfaces. The floor was never guaranteed to be safer.
NOTE 13 [STICKY] The red tearing means DESIGNATION 02 has picked your frame. Move before it drops.
TAPE 02 [09:03] DESIGNATION 02 forms where the signal loses a frame. A rising whine means it is choosing a place to fall. Move clear before the break.
TAPE 02 [09:51] DESIGNATION 02 dives toward the last place it recorded you. The red tearing is the warning. Keep moving after it commits.
TAPE 02 [10:36] Two instances of DESIGNATION 02 have been recorded moving out of sync with each other. This has not been explained.
NOTE 15 [FORM] UNLISTED OCCUPANT. The Guide says it is a voice. It says it is still in the room. Do not ask which is true.
TAPE 02 [11:20] DESIGNATION 01 and 02 share this corridor. During an Auditor scan, enter the gap; neither creature can follow you between frames.
TAPE 02 [12:08] The dust in this hallway was tested. The results were not released to new intake.
TAPE 02 [12:59] Some doors here are monitored from the other side. This is for your protection. We will not say whose.
TAPE 02 [13:44] Intake is complete. Your file has been updated. Tape 03 was recorded below ground level.
TAPE 03 [15:40] ANOMALY: THE PROJECTOR. It replays the room as a beam. The lit band is the frame it is about to erase. Leave that row.
TAPE 03 [15:21] DESIGNATION 03 is a subject who stopped moving so completely that the recording filed them as furniture. Proximity wakes the body. Distance is your only warning.
NOTE 21 [SCRATCHED] IT WAS SITTING THERE WHEN I CAME IN. IT WAS SITTING THERE WHEN I LEFT.
NOTE 21 [SCRATCHED] I HID IN HERE FOR A WHILE. NOBODY CAME LOOKING.
TAPE 03 [19:48] DESIGNATION 04 records the room and sends its image back to the building. When it turns toward you, it has already made a copy of your position.
TAPE 03 [21:02] DESIGNATION 03 responds to proximity, not to sound, not to light. Distance is the only known deterrent.
TAPE 03 [21:55] DESIGNATION 03 moves slower than an average intake subject. When the Auditor begins its red sweep, stillness inside a footage gap is the only safe answer.
NOTE 24 [STICKY] it only wakes up for things it can hear. walk.
TAPE 03 [22:40] Two units of DESIGNATION 04 have overlapping fields of view. There is no angle that is watched by neither.
TAPE 03 [23:31] DESIGNATION 01 is not aware DESIGNATION 03 has been activated in this sector. DESIGNATION 03 does not care either way.
NOTE 26 [FORM] SUBJECT 3: LAST SEEN FACING THE WALL. DO NOT CORRECT THE RECORD.
TAPE 03 [24:15] A DESIGNATION 01 unit and a DESIGNATION 04 unit have been placed in the same corridor deliberately. Study the DESIGNATION 01's timing. The 04 cannot be reasoned with.
TAPE 03 [25:09] Once DESIGNATION 03 activates, DESIGNATION 04 will not pause its recording to let it pass. Elevated surfaces are recommended for both.
TAPE 05 [--:--] ANOMALY: THE WARDEN. It is every failed escape pressed into one body. It has no designation because it is the part of the Program that keeps the count.
